purpose: Pump the asset brain with focused, inspectable asset families related to the current Egg Breakers world instead of broad generic room/lobby searches.

themesRequested: fern plains prehistoric fern herbivore food
rigged dinosaur models playable dino NPC predator prey
jungle basin vines temple prehistoric plants
swamp delta lily pads reeds fish spinosaurus
redstone canyon fossils bones sandstone cliffs
apocalyptic city ruins wrecked cars rubble road signs
mcpPumpResult.lesson: Over-specific multi-concept searches produced sparse results. Next pump passes should use short family queries, then attach winners to story slots after inspection.

dreamGroups.why: The user reported ferns on their side; herbivore starter food and Fern Plains dressing need immediate family-level orientation proof.
acceptanceChecks: single family clean-spot clone captured from front/back/left/right/overhead/player height
fronds upright from player height
bottom geometry grounded with no sideways pivot
edible metadata preserved or stamped only on accepted food roots
all live clones using the same family updated before temp clone cleanup

dreamGroups.why: The user reported face-down dinosaurs; staged species and imported dino candidates need canonical up/forward before player/NPC use.
acceptanceChecks: model feet/down axis visible from clean-spot player-height view
forward axis faces movement/combat/action path rather than ground
helper roots and hitboxes hidden/non-colliding where appropriate
scripted imported dino models quarantined or rejected until reviewed
canonical fix propagated to player, NPC, and staged clone uses

dreamGroups.why: Beat 0 needs a readable egg/nest object that is not generic filler.
acceptanceChecks: egg/nest reads from the spawn path, not only overhead
scale fits hatchling/player camera
no uncontrolled scripts
grounded on nursery floor
safe to mark as required playable visual only after screenshot proof

dreamGroups.why: Carnivore survival needs food that reads as carrion/meat, not an abstract marker or museum fossil.
acceptanceChecks: reads as edible carnivore target from player height
not too large for first food interaction
does not imply non-edible museum-only fossil unless used as dressing
script-free or scripts removed
depletion/restore visual policy documented if used as food

dreamGroups.why: Swamp Delta needs water-surface and shoreline families that are easy to orient and ground.
acceptanceChecks: lily pads sit on water plane
trees/logs are grounded or intentionally waterline-placed
fish remain inside valid water volumes
spino sightline and camera clearance remain playable
family fixes recorded before broad scatter

dreamGroups.why: Canyon needs route-framing rocks, cliffs, fossils, and bones that do not block traversal.
acceptanceChecks: grounded on canyon terrain
does not create stuck spots
fossil display reads as landmark or food according to slot
scale does not occlude the camera on core route
accepted family has orientation metadata before repeated placement

dreamGroups.why: City assets are plentiful but script risk is high; use smaller script-free families first.
acceptanceChecks: script-free or imported scripts quarantined
sign/lamp/car forward direction useful from player path
wrecks and barriers do not trap players
ruins do not block camera or hide core landmarks
family propagation count recorded after placement

dreamGroups.why: Search is still weak for waypoint/scent assets; keep this as a dream lane until a safe UI/particle candidate exists.
acceptanceChecks: no false-direction arrows
no gameplay authority scripts from imported UI without review
readable on mobile and desktop
does not occlude hatch/action UI
kept separate from world placement asset signoff

pumpRules: Prefer focused queries of one family or role at a time.
Do not commit a palette winner from search metadata alone.
Every asset family needs clean-spot screenshots plus at least one in-world player-angle screenshot.
Record inspection metadata before using a family as a repeated placement template.
Reject or quarantine scripted imported content until script source has been reviewed.
nextPumpActions: Run fern_orientation_repair first and record inspections for all accepted/rejected fern candidates.
Run dinosaur_orientation_repair second against the staged/imported dino families currently visible in the place.
After screenshots, update asset-brain/v1/palettes/eggbreakers.json only with pass/fix families that have accepted risk.
